nom: Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep Serum Rice Alpha-Arbutin Niacinamide for Uneven Dull Skin Tone

avis.texte: Wow, I thought I'd get unlucky and that this serum would end up irritating me, but it's actually fine on me! The glow part is real... usually I'm so dull, but this brightens me right up! The difference is pretty freaking noticeable... Stopped using it for a day to see if it was the product making me red and itchy (it was not) and I kinda got jumpscared by the lack of shininess in the mirror. Super lightweight and not sticky! Edit: Ahh, the irritation came. Nothing crazy, but still irritation. I don't know if it's the product's incompatibility with my skin or with the other products in my routine, but I have bid farewell to this... Having sensitive skin sure is difficult...

I’ve been using this serum and I’m really happy with it. It has a lightweight texture, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any greasy residue. With consistent use, my skin looks brighter and more even-toned. It also works great under makeup. I recommend it to anyone looking for a hydrating serum that helps improve the overall appearance of the skin.
Very light but hydrating. I am able to use it daily and put it under my eyes with no issues. I have very sensitive skin and this stuff causes no irritation or build up. Love it.

avis.titre: Far exceeds the price point. In love with these products.
avis.texte: The value is excellent for the cost. After purchasing nearly every Beauty of Joseon product, I followed a full glass skincare routine that ChatGPT created; just four days later, clients at the salon are asking about a change. The outcome already surpasses my Natura Bisse routine, which cost nearly ten times as much. I acquired all these items for less than the Natura $450 night cream. As a 45-year-old male with combination skin and heavily clogged pores, I am seeing blackheads vanish.

avis.titre: If you looking for glowy skin I recommend this!!
avis.texte: Literally love this serum, works super well, easy to apply and is very effective leaves your skin super glowy! I honestly love all the beauty of Josen products!
So far I like it. It goes on very easy and a little goes a long way. I’ve been putting it on at night. After 33 weeks, my skin definitely feels more hydrated.

This serum is okay, nothing great. I used an entire bottle and really didn't see a difference in my skin. I'll stick to my traditional serums. The ordinary makes great serums at a reasonable price that are effective.
The results are okay. It may not work with all skin types though. 4 stars

avis.titre: Ma peau n’a jamais été aussi lumineuse ! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
avis.texte: Complètement conquise par ce sérum Beauty of Joseon ! Après seulement deux semaines d’utilisation, ma peau est visiblement plus éclatante et lumineuse. Le fameux “glow” coréen est bien au rendez-vous ! La texture est absolument parfaite : légère, non grasse et elle pénètre rapidement sans laisser de film collant. Elle convient parfaitement à ma peau mixte. L’association riz et alpha arbutine fait vraiment des merveilles sur les taches pigmentaires et l’uniformité du teint. J’ai remarqué que mes petites imperfections s’estompent progressivement. Le produit est très bien dosé avec la pipette, une ou deux gouttes suffisent pour tout le visage. Le flacon va donc durer longtemps, ce qui rend le rapport qualité-prix excellent. L’odeur est très discrète et agréable. Ma routine skincare est enfin complète grâce à ce sérum ! Ma peau est plus hydratée, repulpée et le grain de peau est affiné. Je le recommande à 100% pour toutes celles et ceux qui cherchent un sérum efficace pour illuminer et unifier leur teint. Un incontournable de la K-beauty !
Best serum which does show result in a couple of months after use.

avis.titre: Que es un producto accesible, sin frangacia y deja la piel bien cuidada
avis.texte: Un producto que en el poco tiempo que lo estoy utilizando a sido gentil con mi piel y he visto su trabajo ñ. 🤗😉🙂👌

avis.titre: Lightweight Serum With a Nice Feel on the Skin
avis.texte: I recently started using the Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep Serum and first impression has been good so far. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin greasy or sticky. I’ve mainly been using it at night after cleansing, and my skin feels softer and looks a bit more hydrated in the morning. It also layers nicely with moisturizer. It hasn’t been very long since I started using it though, so I’ll have to see how it works over the next few weeks for dark spots and overall brightness. One small thing is that the bottle is a little smaller than I expected, but a little product goes a long way. Overall, happy with it up to now.

Me encanta este producto lo que hace que lo uso siento mi piel más suave y brillante. Su textura es ligera y no se hacen grumos cuando aplico mi rutina. Es un buen producto creo que seguiré utilizando estos productos ya que utilizo también la crema y la crema de ojos. 🥰
Me encantó es un producto, que se absorbe bastante rápido el rostro y no deja sensación grasas o ni brillante lo recomiendo

Works EXACTLY as stated. Pores and texture are barely noticeable.I didn't have a huge issue with dark spots or hyperpigmentaton but it cleared up discoloration from a pimple with a few weeks.It also moisturizes and gives a nice glow as well.

Mis resultados son: 1. Mejora la apariencia de los poros y la textura de la piel. 2. Aclara manchas y unifica el color del rostro. 3. Hace lucir la piel más iluminada e hidratada. Antes de opinar me gusta probarlo y así dar una opinión honesta. Mi piel tiene tendencia grasa con un poco se rosacea. Estuve usándolo por 15 días en la mañana y noche. No arde y no me dio ninguna reacción. Suspendí los demás serum de mi rutina para evaluar bien que tanto funcionaba. Solo mantuve mi crema hidratante y protector solar. Gorra y lentes cuando me expongo al sol, tomar suficiente agua y evitar tocar la cara con los dedos en el día a día. Seguiré usándolo y cuando se me acabe lo seguiré comprando. Pruebalo!

I find this serum to be a nice addition to my skin care routine. It helps tone down any redness for me. Helps give that extra nutrients and moisture on my skin barrier. The scent is not offensive at all in fact very subtle. I put it on in the mornings when I can.

I did my research before buying this product and came to the conclusion it would be a good purchase. So far I am not disappointed. The shipping was fast, packaging was secure, product was full. It is an unscented serum that applies easily with the built in dropper. It is not too thick and not too runny, so the perfect consistency. After a couple weeks of using I see less dullness and more vibrance in my complexion. It is moisturizing and seems to minimize the texture and pores. Great value for money.

Just like the other serum of Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep. It does leave the skin glowing and soft, I feel like the price should be a bit less but I got it on sale. No scent to it. Highly recommended for fast results

Originally it was a clear bottle, with a clear tinted yellowish serum. Recently, the bottle has been white and the serum very white and clouded. Idk what changed, but can no longer recommend from this seller. Original Review: After struggling with dark marks and an uneven complexion (most as a result of scars left behind by acne), I feel this has really help. I have noticed improvements in the darks and so far it does a phenomenal job. I have also noticed clearer, brighter skin - I feel moisturized and dewy. I will definitely purchase again and would recommend, as I think it’s worth the money. It doesn’t feel heavy, I don’t notice a scent. At first, I thought it was a bit sticky, by a little goes a long way. It only has that sticky feeling if I apply too much. Just a few drops is good. I use this in the morning, after washing my face. I am mostly indoors. However, don’t forget your sunscreen if you’re hoping to lessen dark marks.

The green box is legitimate. I just posted pictures of it for comparison. I had bought Beauty of Joseon products before, so I found it odd when the label talked about your “f ace” instead of your “face.” But then I noticed the tape that had sealed the box. On the green one, it actually has something for you to scan to verify authenticity. The one with the odd packaging did not. I’m not trying to risk it and use some mystery item when I paid for the real thing, so hopefully my replacement will be legit. If it is, I’ll change my review to reflect that because this actually is a really good product if you get the real thing. If yours comes with the label of authenticity and everything, know that this is a five star product.
